style: avant-garde percussive art-rock and kinetic electronic post-punk, quartal suspension fields and shifting modal drone clusters, angular vowel-stretched intervals with ejective k' t' attacks and glottal a'a stops, 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling over a motorik pulse with telephone busy signal interruptions and thermal printer ticks, spectral freeze drones, dial-up modem negotiations, clavioline, and magnetic tape loops, fiercely ecstatic, nervous, urgent, and relentlessly kinetic, multi-register stem separation with dry close-miked transients and spatial prismatic panned echoes, microtonal bent string friction, granular synthesizer dust clouds, erratic pneumatic valve hisses, fractured clockwork escapements, and industrial water-pipe resonance, sub-bass seismic subharmonics, brutalist metallic percussion, chaotic glitch delays, and hyper-articulate transient transients tearing through frequency voids
lyrics:
[Intro — Dial-up modem carrier lock with thermal printer ticks and steady motorik pulse]
[Spoken Lead — Dry deadpan narrator over magnetic tape loop and subharmonic trautonium drone]
Let's distract ourselves!
[Chorus — Full choral counterpoint lattice with prenasalized mb/nd attacks and ejective k' t' strikes]
WASTING TIME!!
[Interruption — Telephone busy signal cuts through the texture on an external clock]
[Verse 1 — Patter singing with glottal stop punctuation and open-syllable Yoruba pressure]
We multiply the absence until the room cannot find the door.
Every second discarded is a permanent anchor left on the floor.
The pendulum rots in the casing while we invent new shapes to draw.
Nothing demands our attention, so we invent an urgent law.
[Pre-Chorus — Melisma chain launching upward with bright clavioline ornament]
Look at the clock face peel away;
we are inventing a reason to stay.
The gears grind dust into the floorboards below.
Where the seconds vanish, we refuse to know.
[Chorus — Full choir possession with 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling and body percussion stomps]
WASTING TIME!!
[Bridge — Spectral freeze FFT hold on vocal transient, decomposing into noise bursts]
Fuck everything L.O.L.
[Breakdown — Trautonium sliding electronic lead with hocketed vocal relay]
We build the barrier out of the missing piece.
No final tonic resolution; the suspension will not cease.
The architecture of nothing stands tall in the haze.
We lose our coordinates inside the geometric maze.
[Verse 2 — Rapid scatted vowels with Yoruba lexical tone pressure and ejective consonant stops]
An'da mb'a k'a eeee oooh uuuuh!
T'i k'a p'a m'ba s'a nd'a!
K'e nd'a mb'o p'a t'u s'i!
Ooooh aaaa eeee k'uuuuh!
[Interruption — Telephone busy signal interlocks with motorik kick]
[Verse 2B — Accelerated spoken-word staccato over friction-mallet metal percussion]
Spin the wheel of nothing just to hear the axle groan.
We are carving empty symbols into ancient bone.
Collect the useless fractions of an unrecorded year.
Amplifying boredom until boredom sounds like fear.
[Chorus — Massed communal infection with frantic handclaps and township brightness]
Let's distract ourselves!
WASTING TIME!!
[Verse 3 — Whispered polyrhythmic chant over granular dust clouds and thermal noise]
Count the dust motes falling past the bulb.
Swallow the bitter pill of the unanchored ulp.
Keep the machinery spinning just to hear it scream.
We construct our wake inside a vacant, sleepless dream.
The horizon fractures into jagged little shards of glass.
We polish every fragment so the hours cannot pass.
[Verse 3B — Microtonal vocal stretching across shifting oscillator grids]
Stretch the moment thin until the atoms snap apart.
We have built a hollow engine where we used to have a heart.
Feed the furnace index cards and unread daily mail.
Watch the final vestiges of purposeful intent exhale.
[Verse 4 — Extended polymetric chant with rapid-fire consonant clusters and heavy breathing rhythms]
Chase the fading echo down the damp corridor of an abandoned asylum.
We compile useless inventories of nonexistent objects and misalign them.
Measure the exact density of breathable air inside a sealed glass jar.
Pretend that every streetlamp is a distant, dying, irrelevant star.
[Verse 5 — Industrial clatter crescendo with metallic scraping and frantic whispered mantras]
Solder the broken circuit shut just to watch the sparks cascade.
Admire the intricate web of total nothingness that we have made.
Throw another hour into the glowing furnace of pure neglect.
Observe the perfect pattern of systemic errors taking direct effect.
[Bridge 2 — Subharmonic sweep and resonant pipe feedback with frantic tongue clicks]
There is no destination written on the schedule we burned today.
We scatter every option so there is no right path left to obey.
Let the administrative apparatus rust in the pouring rain.
We enjoy the total absence of any functional operating brain.
[Chorus — Maximum density choral outbreak with overlapping polyphonic shouts and stomps]
Let's distract ourselves!
WASTING TIME!!
Fuck everything L.O.L.
[Outro — Perpetual uplift expanding register width and spatial tape echo feedback without final cadence]
Nothing remains of the morning except the mechanical hum.
We sit in the wreckage and wait for the numbness to come.
[End]
caption: An avant-garde percussive art-rock collision driven by quartal suspension fields, 3:2 cross-rhythms, and ejective vocal physics. The track weaves dial-up modem tones, spectral freeze textures, and a choral counterpoint lattice into a relentlessly kinetic exploration of distraction and time-wasting. Built upon a motorik pulse with telephone busy signal interruptions and magnetic tape loops, it escalates from a dry spoken narrator into a massive communal infection without final resolution.
